0022600114.text: The Knicks, now 0-2 and 12th in the East, host the 0-2 Orlando Magic, who are 15th in the East, in New York's third game of the season. Orlando is missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Knicks won their last meeting 132-120 in Orlando on December 13, 2025.
